author: bardic-inspiration
name: Library of Tabletop
summary: The Library's ground floor: a front hall, the great hall of stacks, the Rules Room, the Maintainer's Office, and the stair down to the Repository.
description: Lamplight, dust, and the soft rustle of pages turning by themselves. Every shelf is labeled, every label is cross-referenced, and lately a few of the cross-references point somewhere they should not.

zones.name: Front Hall
zones.note: The way in, past a circulation desk and a card catalogue whose drawers open and close on their own.

zones.name: The Library
zones.note: The great hall of stacks, two stories tall, shelved by kind: spells, items, creatures, and every other sort of entry, each with its own label.

zones.name: Rules Room
zones.note: A quiet reading room whose walls are hung with the master tables: challenge ratings, budgets, and how every number is reckoned.

zones.name: Maintainer's Office
zones.note: A cluttered study of half-finished notes, three cold cups of tea, and a slate of tasks with most of them crossed out.

zones.name: Basement Stair
zones.note: A spiral stair behind a locked grille, winding down into the Repository.
